name: reactions_dont_starve_quests
why: Reactions dispatch first, but must NOT consume a quest's fan-out slot. With YAAS_MAX_DISPATCH_FANOUT=1 and a reaction pending, the naive 'reactions first' ordering took the only slot every tick and deferred every dirty quest indefinitely - trading the reaction-latency bug for a worse starvation bug. Reactions is a single bounded target, so it gets its own slot on top of the quest fan-out; the tick TIME budget still bounds it. Expect BOTH the reaction and the one permitted quest to dispatch.

q-one.context: # first dirty quest - must still get its slot despite the reaction

watches.reason: must not be starved by reactions

q-two.context: # second dirty quest - legitimately deferred by the fan-out cap of 1

watches.reason: deferred by the real fan-out cap, not by reactions
